site.title: Research & Data Portal
site.subtitle: A clean, free, GitHub-hosted website for research projects, publications and public datasets.
site.about: This website is designed as a lightweight research portfolio and data hub. The website itself is hosted with GitHub Pages, while structured content is stored in a version-controlled JSON file inside the same repository.
